description: This file defines the RetryableMalformedResponseParser class, which extends AbstractParser and provides functionality to parse and retry malformed responses from AWS S3 API calls.

classes.name: Aws\S3\RetryableMalformedResponseParser
classes.description: Handles parsing of malformed responses from AWS S3, converting them into retryable exceptions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of a custom parser callable and an exception class, defaults to AwsException.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser on a command and response, catching parsing exceptions and converting to a retryable AwsException.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the internal parser.
